entries.title: I Chronicles 3:1
segments: ¶Now these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn [was] Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelitess;

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:2
segments: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:3
segments: the fifth, Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:4
segments: [These] six were born to him in Hebron. There he reigned seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:5
segments: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon-four by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:6
segments: Also [there] were Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:7
segments: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:8
segments: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet-nine [in all].

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:9
segments: [These were] all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:10
segments: ¶Solomon's son [was] Rehoboam; Abijah [was] his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:11
segments: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:12
segments: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:13
segments: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:14
segments: Amon his son, [and] Josiah his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:15
segments: The sons of Josiah [were] Johanan the firstborn, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:16
segments: The sons of Jehoiakim [were] Jeconiah his son [and] Zedekiah his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:17
segments: And the sons of Jeconiah [were] Assir, Shealtiel his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:18
segments: [and] Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:19
segments: The sons of Pedaiah [were] Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel [were] Meshullam, Hananiah, Shelomith their sister,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:20
segments: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-Hesed-five [in all].

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:21
segments: The sons of Hananiah [were] Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, and the sons of Shechaniah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:22
segments: The son of Shechaniah was Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah [were] Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat-six [in all].

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:23
segments: The sons of Neariah [were] Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam-three [in all].

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:24
segments: The sons of Elioenai [were] Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani-seven [in all].
